conditions.condition_text: Identify if the market is trending up (making higher highs and higher lows) or trending down (making lower lows and lower highs).
For a counter-trend long trade, look below the current swing low and identify the next structural level price is likely to hit.
This level serves as the major structure zone for the counter-trend trade.
Verify that the identified counter-trend level has been tested multiple times (at least two tests).
Multiple tests validate the level as a major structure zone.
Drop down to the 4H chart and wait for the specific reversal confirmation (e.g., double bottom for long, double top for short).
The 4H confirmation signals the reversal intent.
Create a termination zone (box) between the lowest body and the lowest wick of the reversal candle (e.g., double bottom).
This zone defines the area where the reversal confirmation is valid.
Enter on a candlestick pattern showing buying pressure (e.g., engulfing bar, hammer, or close above bar) after the reversal confirmation.
The candlestick pattern confirms bullish momentum after the reversal.
The identified major structure level must have been tested multiple times.
Identify the next structural level price will hit outside of the current trend direction.
Wait for the specific reversal confirmation (e.g., double bottom) on the 4H chart.
The stop is placed one ATR below the lowest wick of the reversal candle.
The speaker uses a fixed target of 1.4 to 1 reward to risk ratio for counter-trend trades.
